scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @trace-ops/contracts build && dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -k -n web,api,collector -c blue,green,yellow "pnpm --filter @trace-ops/web dev" "pnpm --filter @trace-ops/api dev" "pnpm --filter @trace-ops/collector dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @trace-ops/contracts build && pnpm --filter @trace-ops/api build && pnpm --filter @trace-ops/collector build && pnpm --filter @trace-ops/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @trace-ops/contracts build && pnpm --filter @trace-ops/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @trace-ops/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @trace-ops/collector typecheck && pnpm --filter @trace-ops/web typecheck
